title: Your request {seq}

hint.SENT: We have it; nobody has picked it up yet. You can add to it below.
hint.BEING_REVIEWED: Someone in sales is working on it. You can add to it below.
hint.NEED_INFO: We asked you something: answer below.
hint.QUOTE_BEING_PREPARED: We are preparing a quote for it. It comes to you by e-mail when it is ready.
hint.QUOTE_SENT: We sent you a quote by e-mail. You accept it from that e-mail.
hint.QUOTE_ACCEPTED: You accepted the quote: we make the order from it.
hint.ORDER_WAITING: The order waits for our approval. It is not confirmed yet.
hint.ORDER_CONFIRMED: Your order is confirmed. Follow it in Orders & requests.
hint.DECLINED: We cannot take this request. Our message, if we wrote one, is below.
hint.CLOSED: This request is closed. Write below if you still need something.
hint.WITHDRAWN: You withdrew this request. Write below if you still need something.

question.title: We need something from you
question.none: Our question is in the messages below.

missing.title: Request not found
missing.body: This request is not one of yours, or it no longer exists.

failed.title: This request could not be read
failed.body: Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.

offline: No connection — showing what was loaded at {time}

files.title: Add files
files.offline: You are offline: files go when you are back.

withdraw.hint: Possible until we decide on it.
withdraw.title: Withdraw your request {seq}?
withdraw.body: We stop working on it. This cannot be undone: if you change your mind, write to us in the messages below.

problem.changed: This request changed meanwhile: it was read again. Look at it and try again if you still want to.
problem.missing: This request is not one of yours, or it no longer exists.
problem.forbidden: Your access does not let you withdraw requests. Your admin can change that.
problem.network: No connection: nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
problem.failed: It could not be withdrawn: nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
